# Anki Forge

> Anki Forge generates Anki APKG decks from code using Rust, Node / TypeScript or Python.

Current public package version: 0.3.1. Exporting a deck does not require Anki. The APIs available in published packages differ from those in source builds. For updates, keep the original APKG from the previous release; Anki import settings and newer local edits can affect the result.

- Rust: `cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1` (Rust 1.92+)
- Node / TypeScript: `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` (Node.js 22.13+)
- Python: `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+)

- Python: `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+)
